about: Generated 2026-11-20 from the live catalogue (read-only): the group of every species with an Ark model (voyage_species), from its GBIF class and phylum (species_taxonomy). mammal = Mammalia; bird = Aves; reptile = Squamata, Testudines, Crocodylia, Sphenodontia; amphibian = Amphibia; fish = the fish classes, and Chordata with no class (the ray-finned fish); insect = Insecta, Collembola; other = every other invertebrate. A species with no taxonomy row (109) is not listed and is never put in a group. Vertebrates are mammal + bird + reptile + amphibian + fish. SQL: select vs.species_profile_id, st.class_name, st.phylum from voyage_species vs left join species_taxonomy st on st.species_profile_id = vs.species_profile_id.
